evidence.reason: After edit calls metering.reset(), metering.evaluate(units, 0.1, "benchmark"), and returns metering.historySize(), changing both the plan argument and the returned quantity compared to the before version.
Right edit adds an early return for units===0 before the negative check and history splice; this changes behavior for zero-unit calls but does not by itself explain the subscriptionCharge rewrite.
Dependency path states evaluate value-references usageCharge, so subscriptionCharge's new "benchmark" plan argument flows into usageCharge's plan-dependent calculation.
Test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 and historySize() > 0; the new historySize return may satisfy the first assertion but the test does not pin the exact charge semantics, leaving uncertainty.
